Lyrics:
Baby, baby if you leave me 
Can you take me with you 
I can sit in the back seat 
Sometimes when the night is quiet 
I’ll turn all the lights on, like the end of the movie
 
I can’t wait, but I’m waiting 
I’m still up, but I’m fading 

Not so slowly getting older 
California sober 
I live by the water 
Go dancing with my understudy 
Could be anybody 
Make me an offer 
I’m not good, but I’m better 
Missed my cue but whatever 
It’s now or never 

All my life 
Side by side 
Hyde Jekyll Hyde 
Finally together 
You can change your mind 
But you can’t change mine 
Hyde Jekyll Hyde 
You and I forever 

Walking early in the morning 
While you’re still sleeping 
And the credits are rolling 
I don’t know why I’m crying 
Until we’re dead or die trying

-

Phoebe Bridgers - I Can’t Wait (Official Video)
#PhoebeBridgers #ICantWait #LostWeekend

snippet.description:
AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY JUST GOT EVEN BIGGER — AND DOCTOR DOOM LOOKS ABSOLUTELY TERRIFYING!

#AvengersDoomsday #DoctorDoom #RobertDowneyJr #D23 #TrailerReaction #MarvelStudios #MCU #FantasticFour #XMen #ReelRejects 

Aaron Alexander & John Humphrey react to the brand-new Avengers: Doomsday trailer revealed at D23, featuring Robert Downey Jr. as Victor von Doom and a massive collision between the Avengers, Fantastic Four, X-Men, Wakandans, and more. Directed by Anthony & Joe Russo, Avengers: Doomsday stars Robert Downey Jr. (Iron Man, Oppenheimer) as Doctor Doom, Pedro Pascal (The Last of Us, The Mandalorian) as Reed Richards / Mister Fantastic, Vanessa Kirby (The Fantastic Four: First Steps, Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning) as Sue Storm, Chris Hemsworth (Thor, Extraction) as Thor, Patrick Stewart (X-Men, Star Trek: Picard) as Professor X, and Ian McKellen (The Lord of the Rings, X-Men) as Magneto.

After watching the new D23 footage, Aaron and John break down Doctor Doom’s ominous introduction, his green eyes, ceremonial armor, devastated surroundings, and the trailer’s heavy focus on his history with the Fantastic Four. They react to Reed Richards confronting Doom, the emotional hints surrounding Doom’s tragic past, Thor being blasted away with seemingly little effort, and the sheer power and presence Robert Downey Jr. brings to Marvel’s next major villain.

The conversation also explores the massive scope of Avengers: Doomsday, including appearances from Professor X, Magneto, Gambit, Wakandan heroes, Sentinels, and the larger multiversal conflict bringing multiple Marvel worlds together. Aaron and John discuss how the darker visual language surrounding Doom contrasts with the retro-futuristic world of the Fantastic Four, why the Reed and Doom relationship may provide the emotional core of the movie, and whether Doomsday could ultimately reset the MCU timeline heading into Avengers: Secret Wars.

snippet.title: DOOMSDAY D23 Trailer REACTION + BREAKDOWN
snippet.description:
D23 has brought us more DOOMSDAY! During the MARVEL Portion of Disney's huge D23 Event we got a very Special Look at AVENGERS DOOMSDAY revealing even more DOCTOR DOOM! (As well as more X-Men and Incursion Event consequences!) Having seen the Cinemacon Footage as well as all the HALL H Footage I wasn't sure if this would be anything new but I wanted to react and break it all down with you folks! Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and written by Michael Waldron, Stephen McFeely, and the writing team of Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, the film features an ensemble cast led by Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom. In the film, the Avengers, Wakandans, New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and the X-Men converge from different universes to face Doom.

Two new Avengers films, The Kang Dynasty and Secret Wars, were announced in July 2022 as the conclusion of the MCU's Phase Six and "The Multiverse Saga". Jonathan Majors was set to reprise his MCU role as the villain Kang the Conqueror, with Destin Daniel Cretton and Jeff Loveness hired to direct and write The Kang Dynasty, respectively. In November 2023, Cretton departed, Waldron replaced Loveness as writer, and Marvel was considering moving away from the Kang storyline, in part due to Majors's legal issues; Majors was fired the following month. The return of the Russo brothers as directors and McFeely as co-writer, the casting of Downey as new villain Doctor Doom, and the new subtitle Doomsday were all announced in July 2024. The large cast features actors from previous MCU media and 20th Century Fox's X-Men film series, using the idea of colliding universes to bring together actors from different franchises. Filming took place from April to September 2025 at Pinewood Studios in England, with location filming in England and Bahrain.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to be released in the United States on December 18, 2026, as part of Phase Six of the MCU. The sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars, is set to be released on December 17, 2027.

snippet.title: Avengers: Doomsday’s New Trailer Fixed Doom
snippet.description:
The new Avengers: Doomsday trailer finally gives Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom the personal grounding he was missing, using his relationships with Reed Richards and Sue Storm to make Victor von Doom feel like a character rather than simply the MCU's next multiversal threat. I break down what the new Doomsday trailer means for Doctor Doom, Captain America, the X-Men, Fantastic Four and Marvel's returning heroes, while asking what Doom actually wants and how all of these characters can fit into one conflict.

#AvengersDoomsday #DoctorDoom #XMen

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

ENTER THE ARENA
Build your Battle Deck and outsmart the enemy in fast real-time battles. From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS comes a real-time multiplayer battle game starring your favourite Clash characters and more. Start battling against players from around the world!

BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING
Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle!
Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Tower Troops from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS
Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection!

BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world.
Compete for glory and rewards!

SEASONAL EVENTS
Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test!

JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR
Join or form a Clan with other players to share Cards and battle in Clan Wars for BIG rewards!

See you in the Arena!
#ClashRoyale

snippet.title: A DOLLAR Made Him a TRILLIONAIRE! (Roblox Movie)
snippet.description:
🔔 Don't Forget to Like, Comment, and Subscribe!

Check out other ROBLOX MOVIES here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXMiyI1FhhSgcDgEOoHQMQT93IyaHBsBp

Felix has nothing but a single dollar to his name, but he refuses to let that stop him from dreaming big. While his best friend Vince looks for shortcuts to escape poverty, Felix keeps giving away the little he earns to people who need it more. Every act of kindness seems to set him back, costing him food, money, and even his only bike. But when those good deeds begin coming back in unexpected ways, Felix realizes his dollar may be worth far more than he ever imagined. Could doing the right thing really turn him into a TRILLIONAIRE?

ABOUT CLAWED:
Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must fight to survive in this Action-Adventure Survival Horror game. Navigate diverse biomes, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within the park. With danger lurking at every turn, shoot, strategize, and escape before the park becomes your grave.
Play Classic Mode or Survival Mode
Explore a fully realized dinosaur theme park with two distinct gameplay experiences:
Classic Mode: The original Clawed survival horror experience.
Survival Mode: Survive against hunger, thirst, dynamic weather, a full day/night cycle, and random dinosaur encounters as you complete your mission.
Explore Prehistoria, a rundown dinosaur park that has seen better days. Brave deadly dinosaur enclosures, delve into the underground tunnels, and aquatic environments. The entire park is yours to uncover as you make your way through this action-adventure, survival-horror.
Face off against terrifying dinosaurs, from the ruthless Deinosuchus to the swamp dwelling Spinosaurus, Prehistoria is home to many prehistoric creatures.
In traditional survival-horror fashion, your journey through the park will test your mind and wits as you work to solve challenging puzzles and difficult challenges
Fight dinos, explore the park and solve puzzles with your teammates! Invite your friends to join you on your Journey through Prehistoria.

In today’s adventure I decided I’d try to survive what I think is DayZ’s most under-rated map, Livonia. For years I feel it’s been under peoples radars, and deserves a bit more love for what adventures you’re capable of experiencing in these lands. Filled with cool unique points of interest to explore and build at like the prison, the bunker system and more, I embarked on my journey with the sole goal to see if I could make it to the end of the day without dying, and in doing so I found myself accidentally dominating the server...

snippet.title: When the Desert Fox Hunted Desert Rats
snippet.description:
Follow and Wishlist our game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606970?utm_source=0245

May 27th, 1942. General Erwin Rommel leads hundreds of Panzers and ten thousand vehicles of the Afrika Korps charging across the Libyan Desert, around the flank of the British-held Gazala Line, aiming for the vital Allied port of Tobruk. Spearheading the attack of the 15th Panzer Division is a veteran Panzer commander, Capt. Johannes ‘The Lion of Capuzzo’ Kümmel in his Panzer III Ausf. J. Driving northward, his Panzers run straight into the Desert Rats of the British 7th Armored Division. The British M3 Stuart light tanks, led by Lt. Bill Close of the 3rd Royal Tank Regiment, are no match for the formidable Panzers. But the Allies have a trick up their sleeve - the brand new American-made M3 Grant tanks, which the Germans have never fought before. In a titanic battle under the scorching Sun, the desert becomes a tank graveyard with heavy losses on both sides. But the ‘Desert Fox’ Rommel outfoxes the British and emerges victorious.

Sources:

Close, Bill (2013). Tank Commander: From the Fall of France to the Defeat of Germany – The Memoirs of Bill Close.
Forczyk, Robert (2023). Desert Armour: Tank Warfare in North Africa: Gazala to Tunisia, 1942–43.
Ford, Ken and White, John (2008). Gazala 1942: Rommel’s Greatest Victory.
Forty, George (1997). The Armies of Rommel.
Forty, George (2003). 7th Armoured Division: The 'Desert Rats'.
Jörgensen, Christer (2015). Rommel’s High Tide: Gazala 1942.
Liddell Hart, B. H., editor (1953). The Rommel Papers.
Pimlott, John, editor (2014). Rommel: In His Own Words.

Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 is a free-to-play battle royale video game developed by Infinity Ward and Raven Software for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. It is a sequel to 2020's Call of Duty: Warzone. The game is a part of 2022's Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and 2023's Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, but does not require purchase of any of the parent titles. It was introduced during Season 1 of Modern Warfare II content. The game features cross-platform play and a new extraction mode titled DMZ.
